title: the WSG food gathering, foraging and Table 30
audit_comment: The Table 30 grid cell by cell (five climate regions, the chance and inedible percent per terrain per season), the two-turn foraging check with the proficiency advantage and the four-turn search limit, the 1d8 inedible dispatch with the poison and tainted cramp and dice rules - every cell, const, bool and chain limit verified against the model.

banner.title: R463: the WSG FOOD GATHERING AND FORAGING slice - the foraging check with the proficiency advantage, Table 30 (the 33-row terrain-by-season foraging success grid over the five climate regions) and the inedible plants dispatch, printed pp. 53-54.
banner.provenance: Ground truth three-way: the archive djvu word layer vs the pdfy PDF text layer vs the pixel reads of the Table 30 scan (leaf 0053 of the pdfy item, full native 2432x3194 decode). The two text layers disagree or drop the Tem-F winter, St-P/Se/Sw winter, Tro-M winter and Tro-Se spring cells and both garble the Arctic P and Se rows - the pixels settled every one: a glyph-level NCC classifier over same-page font templates (leave-one-out 62/62) plus vision reads of the contrast-stretched cell crops, every disputed digit at 0.83-0.94 correlation with the runner-up 0.2-0.3 behind.
banner.sentinel: All 132 grid cells pinned; the foraging mechanics (the two-turn check, the proficient 2-in-2 or 1-in-1, the -20 inedible shift, the four-turn search limit, the one-mile move-on, the 1d8 inedible bands) are audit examples.

consts.name: wfgCheckTurnsNormal
consts.comment: a normal character forages two turns per check: the chance to find one full day's ration

consts.name: wfgRationPounds
consts.comment: one full day's ration of plant life is two pounds of fruit, vegetables and/or greenery

consts.name: wfgProfRationsPerCheck
consts.comment: with the foraging proficiency: two full rations located in the same two turns of foraging

consts.name: wfgProfTurnsPerRation
consts.comment: with the proficiency: one full ration located in one turn of foraging

consts.name: wfgProfInedibleReduction
consts.comment: with the proficiency: the chance of the take being inedible is 20% lower than a normal character's

consts.name: wfgSearchTurnsMax
consts.comment: fruitless to spend more than four turns attempting to find food - no further searching produces better results

consts.name: wfgChecksMaxNormal
consts.comment: the four-turn limit is two foraging checks for a normal character

consts.name: wfgChecksMaxProf
consts.comment: the four-turn limit is four foraging checks for one with the proficiency

consts.name: wfgMilesBeforeReforage
consts.comment: after a fruitless search the group must travel at least one mile before foraging again

consts.name: wfgArcRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 Arctic grid rows: desert, hills, mountains, plains and scrublands - no forest or swamp row

consts.name: wfgSubRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 Subarctic grid rows (the standard seven terrains)

consts.name: wfgTemRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 Temperate grid rows (the standard seven terrains)

consts.name: wfgStiRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 Subtropical grid rows (the standard seven terrains)

consts.name: wfgTroRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 Tropical grid rows (the standard seven terrains)

consts.name: wfgInedRollMax
consts.comment: the inedible-plants dispatch roll is 1d8

consts.name: wfgPoisonCrampOnsetDie
consts.comment: poisonous plants: cramps begin 1d10 rounds after eating

consts.name: wfgPoisonCrampTurnsDice
consts.comment: poisonous plants: the cramps last 2d10 turns

consts.name: wfgPoisonCrampTurnsDie
consts.comment: poisonous plants: the cramp duration die is d10

consts.name: wfgPoisonHpPerTurnDie
consts.comment: poisonous plants: 1d4 hit points lost per turn while the cramps persist

consts.name: wfgPoisonRegainPerHourDie
consts.comment: poisonous plants: hit points regained at 1d4 per hour with rest

consts.name: wfgPoisonRestWaterPintsPerHour
consts.comment: the poison recovery requires at least one pint of water per hour while resting

consts.name: wfgSlowPoisonSaveStackNum
consts.comment: slow poison on a character who made his save: one-fourth duration and damage

consts.name: wfgSlowPoisonSaveStackDen
consts.comment: slow poison on a character who made his save: the one-fourth denominator

consts.name: wfgTaintCrampOnsetDie
consts.comment: tainted plants: cramps begin within 1d10 rounds

consts.name: wfgTaintCrampTurnsDie
consts.comment: tainted plants: the cramps last 1d10 turns

consts.name: wfgTaintHpPerTurnDie
consts.comment: tainted plants: 1d2 hit points lost per turn while the cramps persist

consts.name: wfgTaintHalfNum
consts.comment: tainted plants affect the consumer as half-strength poison

consts.name: wfgTaintHalfDen
consts.comment: the tainted half-strength denominator

bools.name: wfgProfFindChanceNormal
bools.comment: the proficient character's chance of locating potentially edible plants is no greater than any other character's

bools.name: wfgPoisonHalfRationTriggers
bools.comment: poisonous plants hit anyone who eats a half-ration or more

bools.name: wfgPoisonSaveHalves
bools.comment: a saving throw versus poison halves both the cramp duration and the damage

bools.name: wfgSlowPoisonActsAsSave
bools.comment: a slow poison spell acts the same as a successful saving throw

bools.name: wfgNeutralizeHaltsCramps
bools.comment: a neutralize poison spell halts the cramps and negates any damage that would be suffered subsequently

bools.name: wfgNeutralizeNoPriorDamage
bools.comment: neutralize poison does not negate damage taken before the spell was applied

bools.name: wfgTaintSaveHalves
bools.comment: tainted plants: a saving throw versus poison reduces duration and damage by half

bools.name: wfgTaintCureDiseaseHalts
bools.comment: tainted plants: a neutralize poison or cure disease spell halts duration and damage as soon as it is cast

bools.name: wfgNoValueWaterOnly
bools.comment: the 5-8 no-value plants provide no food value aside from the water they might contain

bools.name: wfgNoValueFullNoNourish
bools.comment: no-value plants fill the stomach but affect the system as though no food was eaten

bools.name: wfgOrchardGuaranteed
bools.comment: camp in an apple grove or a cornfield edge: a 100% chance of coming back with food, whatever the table says

bools.name: wfgRipePickedInedibleNearZero
bools.comment: gathering all the ripe fruit from the trees instead of picking some up off the ground: little or no chance the food is inedible

bools.name: wfgTableNotUnerring
bools.comment: the table must not unswervingly dictate what happens - common sense and reasonable judgment prevail

bools.name: wfgGroupMustMoveOn
bools.comment: if every character searches the limit and no food is found, the group must move on before foraging again

chains.name: wfgInedBandFor
chains.comment: the inedible-plants band on 1d8: 1 poisonous band 0, 2-4 tainted band 1, 5-8 no food value band 2

examples.note: the subarctic forest winter forage: 70% find chance, 40% inedible
the proficient take: two rations per two-turn check or one per turn
the proficient inedible shift on the temperate forest spring cell: 40 - 20 = 20
the search limit: four turns is two normal checks, four proficient checks

examples.note: the ration weight: one day's ration is two pounds
the arctic desert winter: nothing to find
the move-on rule: at least one mile before foraging again

table_checks.note: the inedible roll 1 is the poison band, 4 tainted, 5 no value
